nom: TATCHA The Dewy Serum with Hyaluronic Acid & Collagen Amino Acid

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily-leaning skin says the serum works well in cooler weather without adding a heavy layer, and another describes her oily-sensitive skin as loving the product with no residue.
segments.dry: Multiple reviewers with dry skin (including desert and Arizona climates) report the serum adds lasting moisture, softness, and glow without feeling greasy; one dry-skin reviewer says it made the biggest difference after her skin had become very dry.
segments.combination: One reviewer describes years of combo-dry, textured, hormonal-acne-prone skin and reports the serum finally gave her a visible glow and improved texture and tone.
segments.sensitive: Reports are split: several sensitive-skin users say the serum is unexpectedly non-irritating, calming, and even reduced redness, while others with sensitive or reactive skin report stinging, rashes, or breakouts.
segments.mature: Multiple reviewers in their 60s-80s report visibly softer lines, plumper skin, and firming effects, and one calls it essential for anyone starting anti-aging skincare from age 25 on.

concerns.aging: Several older reviewers (ages 60-82) report softened fine lines and wrinkles and firmer, plumper-looking skin; one calls it part of a routine that noticeably smoothed lines.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including those in dry or high-desert climates, report the serum keeps skin hydrated, plump, and dewy all day without feeling heavy or greasy; one reviewer felt it left a filmy residue that had to be washed off.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports switching to this and other Tatcha products left her skin less irritated and calmer overall; another reports the opposite, with dark red spots appearing on her face after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with sensitive skin describes past correctors as too harsh but says this serum and the Tatcha line left her skin calmer and less irritated; a different reviewer reports a severe reaction requiring emergency antibiotic treatment after a swollen, infected pore.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers report visible fading of dark or sun spots within days of use, with one calling the results unbelievable and another saying it happened within two days.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports daily new breakouts that cleared only after stopping use; another describes a serious boil/infection on her chin; a third reports a rash and stinging; these contrast with the many reviewers reporting no breakout issues.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with normally oily-leaning skin reports the texture doesn't feel like an added layer and suits her skin well in cooler months when it turns drier; no reviewer with oily skin reports increased shine or oiliness from the product.

aspects.libelle: Bottle appears larger than actual fill
